interpretation: An unedited GUI round trip preserves the custom LTYPE definition and LINE group 6 for both ASCII and binary source files.

The unedited VENDOR_BINARY line visibly renders its [10,-5] dash pattern. The Properties panel still labels the selected entity Continuous, and its standard linetype control does not expose the imported custom name.

Moving the LINE loses group 6 even when both current-attribute and current-layer overrides are disabled. The moved output retains the LTYPE table but writes the entity reference as ByLayer; after reopen the entity uses the layer style. No-op save/reopen evidence cannot close the edit-preservation requirement.

gate_disposition.reason: LibreCAD 2 edit/reopen changes the entity linetype reference, the Properties panel does not expose the imported name, and LibreCAD_3 MPOLYGON GUI round trip plus pinned ezdxf readback remain incomplete.
